answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to lock a decaying bond that only vests after it publishes a unique work diary that three uncorrelated observer sets countersign. One set watches from a knoll, a high vantage over repeated outputs; another records inbound requests at a harbor jetty so cloned traffic patterns surface; each observer signs with a one-epoch quill, a single-use key that cannot be reused to rubber-stamp siblings. Farms fail because they cannot buy uncorrelated witnesses cheaply, and unvested bonds are slashed.
